case_number: 2024 INSC 960; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. ____ OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.7957 of 2024)
summary: Abetment of suicide; cruelty under IPC s.498A; twelve-year marriage; streedhan (ornaments) sold twelve months prior to death; no prior complaints; prima facie case standard: strong suspicion based on witness statements; mens rea required for s.306 IPC; discharge denied for s.306/498A; charge framing upheld; harassment constitutes mental cruelty; no requirement for immediate death after harassment.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.306, s.498A, s.114, s.107
State of A.P. v. M. Madhusudhan Rao
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court order upheld; appellants to face trial.
